On Thu, Jul29,2021 at7:46 PM Clare Amador<[contact omitted]>wrote:
Hi Ron and Joey,
10am August 6 works. Would be happy to see Ivy!
I will bring Nixon, my colleague with me as well.

For Agenda, we hope we can explore the ff areas: (but we don't need to be limited by these)
• Boses/Participate Survey
Impact of disinformation to elections decisions and behaviour
• Possible training for COMELEC field offices on resiliency (mental health) and digital literacy)
• Conversation with COMELEC and the Ads Industry for elections
• Industry Code of Conduct
• Ads policies for elections advertising
• Long-term: Research on Misinformation, Slurs
See you on Aug6!
Clare
